Label: Nickel Plating
Description: A process where a thin layer of nickel is electrochemically deposited onto a metal surface to enhance corrosion resistance and wear properties.

Label: Nitriding
Description: A process that involves diffusing nitrogen into the surface of a metal to create a hard, wear-resistant layer.

Label: Notching
Description: A process that involves cutting angular or V-shaped indentations along the edge or surface of a workpiece, typically using a press.

Label: Oil Grooving
Description: A process where specific channels are cut into components to facilitate the distribution and retention of lubricating oil.

Label: Oil Quench Hardening
Description: A process where steel is heated to a specific temperature, then rapidly cooled in oil to increase hardness and toughness.

Label: Open Die Forging
Description: A process where a workpiece is deformed between a set of open dies that do not enclose the material entirely, allowing metal flow.

Label: Oxy-Fuel Cutting
Description: A process where a mixture of oxygen and fuel gases is used to generate a flame, capable of cutting through materials like steel.

Label: Oxyacetylene Cutting
Description: A process where a high-temperature flame from burning acetylene with oxygen melts and cuts metal through localized oxidation and rapid heating.

Label: PCB Assembly
Description: A process where electronic components are mounted and soldered onto printed circuit boards using methods such as surface-mount, through-hole, or mixed assembly.

Label: PCB Fabrication
Description: A process where bare printed circuit boards are manufactured through steps such as lamination, photolithography, etching, drilling, plating, and surface finishing before component assembly

Label: Packing
Description: A process where finished products are securely enclosed in containers or packaging materials for protection, storage, and transportation.

Label: Passivation
Description: A process that involves treating or coating a metal to reduce the chemical reactivity of its surface, enhancing its corrosion resistance.

Label: Peen Forming
Description: A process where controlled shot impacts induce plastic deformation, creating curvature in metal sheets by generating compressive stresses on the surface.

Label: Peening
Description: A process that involves bombarding a metal surface with small spheres to induce compressive stresses, enhancing fatigue resistance and preventing crack propagation.

Label: Percussion Welding
Description: A process where rapid, controlled energy pulses create high-intensity impacts to fuse materials together without the need for filler metals or fluxes.

Label: Perforating
Description: A process where holes are precisely punched or drilled into materials to enhance functionality, such as ventilation, filtration, or weight reduction.

Label: Permanent Mold Casting
Description: A process where molten metal is poured into a reusable mold, cooled, and solidified to form a part, known as permanent mold casting.

Label: Phosphate Coating
Description: A process where metal surfaces are treated with a solution of phosphoric acid and phosphates to form a protective, corrosion-resistant layer.

Label: Phosphate Conversion Coating
Description: A process where a metal surface is treated with a phosphate solution to form a layer of insoluble crystalline phosphates for corrosion resistance and paint adhesion.

Label: Phosphating
Description: A process that applies a phosphate coating to metal surfaces to enhance corrosion resistance, improve paint adhesion, and reduce friction.

Label: Photo Etching
Description: A process where metal sheets are selectively dissolved using chemical etchants through a photoresist mask to create precise, intricate patterns.

Label: Photochemical Machining
Description: A process where controlled photochemical reactions remove material to form precise, complex metal parts with tight tolerances.

Label: Photolithography
Description: A process where light is used to transfer geometric patterns from a mask onto a photoresist-coated substrate for semiconductor or microfabrication applications.

Label: Photopolymerization
Description: A process where liquid photopolymer resins are selectively cured by light exposure, forming solid structures through polymer chain cross-linking.

Label: Physical Vapor Deposition
Description: A process where material is vaporized from a solid source and condensed onto a substrate, forming a thin film, in a vacuum environment.

Label: Pickling
Description: A process that removes oxides and scale from metal surfaces using acidic solutions, enhancing surface finish and preparing for subsequent treatments.

Label: Piercing
Description: a process ability to consistently produce products or services that meet customer specifications or requirements.

Label: Pipe Bending
Description: A process where pipes are plastically deformed using mechanical force or heat to achieve specific angles or curves without compromising structural integrity.

Label: Planarization
Description: A process that involves flattening and smoothing a surface to achieve a uniform, level plane in semiconductor manufacturing.

Label: Planing
Description: A process that involves shaving off layers from a material's surface to achieve a smooth, flat finish using a planing machine.

Label: Plasma Arc Welding
Description: A process where a constricted plasma arc melts the workpiece and filler material, creating a joint upon solidification.

Label: Plasma Cutting
Description: A process where an accelerated jet of hot plasma cuts through electrically conductive materials, utilizing high-speed, precision-guided technology.

Label: Plasma Enhanced Chemical Vapor Deposition
Description: A process where plasma is used to enhance chemical vapor deposition, enabling thin film deposition at lower temperatures with improved film quality and adhesion.

Label: Plasma Spraying
Description: A process where a high-temperature plasma jet melts particles, which are then sprayed onto a substrate to form a coating.

Label: Plaster Mold Casting
Description: A process where a plaster mixture is used to create a mold for casting non-ferrous materials, typically involving a two-part mold system.

Label: Plastic Machining
Description: A process where solid blocks of plastic are precisely cut, drilled, or shaped using specialized tools or CNC machines to create specific components.

Label: Plastic Processing Capability
Description: A capability to process plastics.

Label: Plate Rolling
Description: A process where metal plates are passed through rollers to reduce thickness and form cylindrical or conical shapes with precise dimensions.

Label: Plating
Description: A process where a thin layer of metal is deposited onto the surface of a workpiece to enhance corrosion resistance, wear resistance, or aesthetics.

Label: Plunge Grinding
Description: A process where a workpiece is ground by a grinding wheel, moving axially into the workpiece to remove material.

Label: Polishing
Description: A process that involves abrading materials to a smooth, reflective surface, reducing surface roughness and removing surface defects.

Label: Polycrystalline Diamond Machining
Description: A process where a polycrystalline diamond, a high-performance cutting tool material, is used to machine extremely hard and abrasive materials.

Label: Polymer Deposition
Description: The process of creating a layer of polymer material on a substrate.

Label: Powder Bed Fusion
Description: A process where a laser or electron beam selectively fuses powdered material layer-by-layer to create complex, high-precision 3D components.

Label: Powder Coating
Description: A process where dry, free-flowing thermoplastic or thermoset powder material is applied to a surface, then cured under heat to form a solid coating.

Label: Powder Compacting
Description: A process where metal or ceramic powders are compressed into a solid mass using a die, achieving high density and structural integrity.

Label: Powder Deposition
Description: The process where materials are added in powder form to a molten pool created by a high-energy source, typically a laser or electron beam.

Label: Powder Metal Forming
Description: A process where metallic powders are compacted under high pressure and heated to form solid metal parts through sintering.

Label: Powder Metallurgy
Description: A process where metal powders are compacted and sintered to form solid components with precise dimensions and controlled microstructures.

Label: Precision Boring
Description: A process where boring operations are performed with high accuracy and fine tolerances to achieve precise hole diameters and smooth finishes.

Label: Precision Cutting
Description: A process where materials are cut with high accuracy and fine tolerances using specialized tools or advanced cutting technologies.

Label: Precision Fabrication
Description: A process where fabrication techniques are applied with tight tolerances and high accuracy to produce components for critical applications such as aerospace, defense, and medical devices.

Label: Precision Machining
Description: A process where advanced machining methods are used to achieve tight tolerances, fine surface finishes, and high dimensional accuracy.

Label: Precision Metal Cutting
Description: A process where metals are cut with fine tolerances and smooth finishes using advanced cutting methods such as laser, EDM, or waterjet.

Label: Precision Molding
Description: A process where molding techniques are applied with tight tolerances and fine detail to produce high-accuracy parts for critical applications.

Label: Precision PCB Assembly
Description: A process where electronic components are assembled on printed circuit boards with high accuracy, tight tolerances, and strict quality standards.

Label: Precision Welding
Description: A process where welding techniques are applied with tight control to achieve high accuracy, minimal heat distortion, and fine detail for critical applications.

Label: Press Fitting
Description: A process where components are joined by being pressed into each other under high pressure, creating a tight, secure connection without welding or adhesives.

Label: Press Forging
Description: A process where metal is heated and shaped under high pressure using a press, resulting in high-strength, durable components.

Label: Press Forming
Description: A process where sheet metal is shaped by applying pressure through a die, utilizing mechanical or hydraulic presses to achieve precise geometries.

Label: Press Work
Description: A process where metal sheets are shaped and cut using a press machine, employing dies and punches to achieve precise dimensions and geometries.

Label: Pressure Welding
Description: A process where metals are joined under high pressure and elevated temperature, causing coalescence without the need for a filler material.

Label: Painting
Description: A process where a protective or decorative coating is applied to a surface using various methods such as spraying, brushing, or dipping.

Label: Process Annealing
Description: A process where metals are heated below their recrystallization temperature, then cooled to reduce hardness and increase ductility for further processing.

Label: Progressive Press Stamping
Description: a high-speed, automated metal forming process where a strip of metal is fed continuously through a stamping press equipped with a progressive die.

Label: Projection Welding
Description: A process where two metal pieces are joined by applying heat and pressure, generated by electric current, through a shaped electrode.

Label: Pulsed Gas Metal Arc Welding
Description: A process where a consumable wire electrode is fed continuously, and the welding current is pulsed to provide better control over heat input, spatter reduction, and improved weld quality, especially in thin or out-of-position materials.

Label: Pulsed Gas Tungsten Arc Welding
Description: A process where a non-consumable tungsten electrode is used to produce an arc, and the welding current is pulsed to control heat input and improve weld quality, commonly used for precision welding of thin or heat-sensitive materials.

Label: Pultrusion
Description: A process where continuous fibers are impregnated with resin and pulled through a heated die to form constant cross-section composite profiles.

Label: Punching
Description: A process where a punch press applies high force to a tool or die, creating holes in a workpiece by removing material.

Label: Quench Hardening
Description: A process where metal is rapidly cooled from austenitizing temperature to increase hardness and strength by forming martensitic microstructures.

Label: Quenching
Description: A process where heated metal is rapidly cooled in water, oil, or air to increase hardness and strength by altering its microstructure.

Label: Ram EDM
Description: A process that utilizes electrical discharges to remove material from a workpiece, specifically through a series of rapidly recurring current discharges.

Label: Reaction Injection Molding
Description: A process where two liquid components are mixed and injected into a mold to chemically react and form a thermosetting polymer.

Label: Reaming
Description: A process that involves enlarging pre-drilled holes to precise dimensions using a multi-edged fluted cutting tool known as a reamer.

Label: Recovery Annealing
Description: A process where heat treatment is applied to cold-worked metal to restore its ductility and reduce its hardness and internal stresses.

Label: Recrystallization
Description: A process where a material is heated to high temperatures to form new, strain-free grains, reducing defects and enhancing mechanical properties.

Label: Resin Transfer Molding
Description: A process where a fiber preform is placed into a mold, and then liquid resin is injected to impregnate the fibers and harden into shape.

Label: Resistance Brazing
Description: A process where heat is generated through electrical resistance to join metal pieces using a filler metal, without melting the base materials.

Label: Resistance Soldering
Description: A process where heat generated from electrical resistance is used to melt solder, creating a robust joint between two metal pieces.

Label: Resistance Spot Welding
Description: A process where metal surfaces are joined by applying pressure and heat generated from an electrical current through electrodes at the weld point.

Label: Resistance Welding
Description: A process where electrical resistance generates heat to join metal surfaces by applying pressure, forming a weld without additional filler materials.

Label: Ring Rolling
Description: A process where a pre-formed metal ring is incrementally deformed between rollers to increase diameter and reduce wall thickness, enhancing material properties.

Label: Riveting
Description: A process where two or more materials are joined together using a rivet, a non-removable mechanical fastener, to create a strong, permanent assembly.

Label: Robotic Welding
Description: A process where industrial robots perform automated welding operations to achieve consistent quality, high productivity, and precision in mass production.

Label: Roll Bonding
Description: A process where two or more metal sheets are joined by applying pressure and heat, causing atomic diffusion at the interface.

Label: Roll Coating
Description: A process where a substrate is coated by transferring a liquid film from a rotating roller, ensuring uniform thickness and surface coverage.

Label: Roll Die Engraving
Description: A process where a hardened image is engraved onto a roll die to imprint patterns or designs onto a material during production.

Label: Roll Forging
Description: A process that involves continuously hammering a long, heated metal piece between two cylindrical or semi-cylindrical rolls to reduce its thickness.

Label: Roll Forming
Description: A process where metal strips are continuously bent into a specified cross-sectional profile through a series of roll stands.

Label: Roller Forming
Description: A process where rollers progressively shape metal sheets or strips by applying pressure, enhancing material properties and achieving precise dimensional tolerances.

Label: Rolling
Description: A process that reduces the thickness of a long workpiece by compressive forces applied through a set of rolls.

Label: Rotary Broaching
Description: A process where a specially designed tool is rotated and pressed into a workpiece to cut complex shapes like hexagonal or square holes.

Label: Rotational Molding
Description: A process where a heated hollow mold is filled with a material and then slowly rotated, causing the softened material to disperse and stick to the walls.

Label: Rotomolding
Description: A process where powdered plastic is heated and rotated in a mold to form hollow, seamless, and uniform-walled parts.

Label: Rubber Injection Molding
Description: A process where heated rubber is injected into a mold under high pressure to produce precise, high-volume rubber parts.

Label: Sand Blasting
Description: A process where high-speed streams of sand particles are propelled towards a surface to clean or etch it.

Label: Sand Casting
Description: A process where molten metal is poured into a sand mold to form complex metal parts through solidification.

Label: Sawing
Description: A process where materials such as wood or metal are cut into specific dimensions using a tool with a hard, serrated edge, known as a saw.

Label: Screen Printing
Description: A process where ink, paste, or functional materials are forced through a mesh stencil onto a surface to create patterns or coatings.

Label: Seam Welding
Description: A process where two metal sheets are joined by continuously creating a weld along their touching edges using heat and pressure.

Label: Selective Laser Melting
Description: The process is where a high-powered laser selectively melts and fuses metal powder, layer by layer, to create solid 3D parts.

Label: Selective Laser Sintering
Description: The process that uses a laser to selectively fuse powdered materials, layer by layer, to create a solid object

Label: Selective Mask Sintering
Description: The process uses IR light and a digitally printed optical mask to sinter or melt layers of plastic powder selectively.

Label: Semiconductor Fabricating
Description: A process where integrated circuits are produced on semiconductor materials, involving photolithography, etching, doping, and metallization.

Label: Semiconductor Industry
Description: The semiconductor industry.

Label: Servo Press Stamping
Description: A metal forming process where a servo-driven press precisely controls speed, position, and force to stamp sheet metal into desired shapes.

Label: Sewing
Description: A process where fabrics or materials are joined using a needle and thread, either by hand or with a sewing machine.

Label: Shape Rolling
Description: A process where metal stock passes through rollers to reduce thickness and alter cross-sectional profile, enhancing mechanical properties and dimensional accuracy.

Label: Shaping
Description: A process where raw materials are manipulated, through methods such as cutting or forming, to create specific geometrical configurations.

Label: Shear Forming
Description: A process where a rotating metal blank is incrementally deformed by a roller tool to reduce thickness and form conical or cylindrical shapes.

Label: Shear Spinning
Description: A process where a rotating metal blank is incrementally deformed over a mandrel using a roller, reducing thickness while maintaining diameter.

Label: Shearing
Description: A process where a machine or tool applies a large cutting force to a material, causing it to break along a straight line without forming chips or using heat.

Label: Sheet Bending
Description: A process where flat metal sheets are plastically deformed along a straight axis to create an angular bend, altering their geometry and structural properties.

Label: Sheet Forming
Description: A process where flat metal sheets are plastically deformed into specific geometries using dies, punches, or rollers, maintaining material continuity and thickness.

Label: Sheet Metal Processing
Description: A process where flat sheets of metal are manipulated into specific geometries through operations such as cutting, bending, and assembling.

Label: Sheet Metal Rolling
Description: A process where metal sheets are passed through rollers to reduce thickness and achieve uniform cross-section, enhancing material properties and dimensional accuracy.

Label: Sheet Rolling
Description: A process where metal sheets are passed through rollers to reduce thickness and improve uniformity, enhancing mechanical properties and surface finish.

Label: Shell Molding
Description: A process where resin-coated sand is heated and formed into a mold, which is then filled with molten metal to create precise castings.

Label: Shielded Metal Arc Welding
Description: A process where an electric current is used to join metals together using a flux-coated electrode, creating a shielded gas environment.

Label: Short Cycle Annealing
Description: A process where materials are heated to below their recrystallization temperature, then cooled rapidly to improve ductility and reduce hardness.

Label: Shot Peening
Description: A process where small spherical shot is blasted against a surface to induce compressive residual stresses, enhancing fatigue strength and reducing metal failure.

Label: Shrink Fitting
Description: A process where components are heated or cooled to alter their dimensions for interference fit assembly, exploiting thermal expansion or contraction.

Label: Silver Plating
Description: A process where a thin layer of silver is electrochemically deposited onto a conductive surface to enhance conductivity, reflectivity, and corrosion resistance.

Label: Singeing
Description: A process where fabric surfaces are exposed to a flame or heated plates to remove protruding fibers, enhancing smoothness and preventing pilling.

Label: Single-Point Cutting
Description: A process where a single-point cutting tool removes material from a workpiece to create a smooth surface or specific feature.

Label: Sinker EDM
Description: A process where electrical discharges are used to machine complex cavities in hardened steel by utilizing a graphite or copper electrode.

Label: Sintering
Description: A process where powdered material is heated to a temperature below its melting point to form a solid mass through atomic diffusion.

Label: Skiving
Description: A process where thin layers are shaved from a material's surface using a precision blade, enhancing dimensional accuracy and surface finish.

Label: Slab Milling
Description: A process where a rotating cutting tool removes material from a workpiece in a direction perpendicular to its axis, producing a flat surface.

Label: Slitting
Description: A process where a coil of material is cut longitudinally into narrower strips using sharp rotary blades.

Label: Slotting
Description: A process where a vertically reciprocating cutting tool removes material to produce slots, grooves, or keyways in a workpiece.

Label: Small Disadvantaged Business
Description: Small disadvantaged business status.

Label: Small Hole Drilling
Description: A process where precise, miniature holes are created in a material using specialized drilling machines or laser technology.

Label: Soldering
Description: A process where two or more metal items are joined together by melting and flowing a filler metal into the joint.

Label: Solid Deposition
Description: The process where a substance changes directly from a gas (or vapor) phase into a solid phase, bypassing the liquid state.

Label: Spark Plasma Sintering
Description: A process where rapid, pulsed direct current creates heat, facilitating the consolidation and synthesis of powders into solid materials via sintering.

Label: Special Business Status Classifier
Description: Classifier for special business status (e.g. minority-owned).

Label: Specialized Machining
Description: A process where specific, advanced machinery is utilized to create intricate parts with high precision and accuracy.

Label: Spin Casting
Description: A process where molten material is poured into a rotating mold, utilizing centrifugal force to evenly distribute and solidify the material into a casting.

Label: Spin Forming
Description: A process where a metal blank is rotated and formed over a mandrel using localized pressure to create axially symmetric parts.

Label: Spinning
Description: A process where fibers are drawn out and twisted together to create yarn or thread, typically using a spinning wheel or industrial machinery.

Label: Spiral Forming
Description: A process where sheet metal or strip is wound into a spiral or helical shape to produce tubes, ducts, springs, or structural components.

Label: Spot Welding
Description: A process where two metal surfaces are joined by applying heat and pressure, generated from an electrical current, at specific points.

Label: Square Tubing
Description: A process where flat, strip steel is formed, welded, and cut into specific lengths to produce hollow, square-shaped tubes.

Label: Squeeze Casting
Description: A process where molten metal is forced into a preheated die under high pressure, solidifying under pressure to produce a dense, high-strength casting.

Label: Stainless Steel Processing Capability
Description: A capability to process stainless steel.

Label: Stamping
Description: A process where a flat sheet metal is shaped by a die through pressing, punching, or bending operations under high pressure.

Label: Standard Machining
Description: A process where material is removed from a workpiece using cutting tools to achieve precise dimensions and surface finishes through controlled material removal.

Label: State
Description: A state or province.

Label: Steel Processing Capability
Description: A capability to process steel.

Label: Stereolithography
Description: The process uses a liquid photopolymer resin, also known as resin, which is cured layer by layer using a UV laser or light source.

Label: Sterilization
Description: A process where products, tools, or materials are treated to eliminate microorganisms using heat, chemicals, radiation, or other methods.

Label: Stress Relieving
Description: A process where residual stresses in a material are reduced or eliminated through heating, holding, and cooling operations.

Label: Stretch Blow Molding
Description: A process where preheated plastic parisons are inflated to form a hollow product using high-pressure air in a mold.

Label: Stretch Forming
Description: A process where a metal piece is stretched and bent simultaneously over a die to create contoured parts.

Label: Stretching
Description: A process where material is elongated under tension to enhance mechanical properties, improve uniformity, and achieve specific dimensional characteristics.

Label: Stud Welding
Description: A process where a metal stud is joined to a workpiece through heat generated from electrical resistance, creating a high-quality, load-bearing weld.

Label: Submerged Arc Welding
Description: A process where coalescence is produced by heating with an arc between a bare metal electrode and the workpiece, under a blanket of granular flux.

Label: Superplastic Forming
Description: A process where metals are heated to high temperatures and formed into complex shapes using low-pressure gas, exploiting their superplasticity properties.

Label: Surface Blasting
Description: A process where abrasive materials are propelled against a surface to remove contaminants, improve texture, or prepare for coating applications.

Label: Surface Coating
Description: A process where a substrate is covered with a layer of material to enhance properties such as corrosion resistance, wear resistance, or aesthetics.

Label: Surface Finishing
Description: A process where material surfaces are altered to obtain specific properties, such as smoothness, glossiness, or roughness, through techniques like polishing, buffing, or sanding.

Label: Surface Grinding
Description: A process where a rotating grinding wheel removes material from the surface of a workpiece to achieve flatness, fine finishes, and precise thickness.

Label: Surface Hardening
Description: A process that involves altering the properties of the surface layer of a metal to enhance its hardness and resistance to wear and fatigue.

Label: Surface Mount Technology
Description: A process where electronic components are placed and soldered directly onto the surface of printed circuit boards using automated assembly methods.

Label: Surface Preparation
Description: A process where the surface of a material is cleaned, treated, or modified to enhance adhesion, corrosion resistance, or paint application.

Label: Swagging
Description: A process that involves reducing the diameter of an object by forcing it through a die or forming it around a mandrel.

Label: Swedging
Description: A process where metal is plastically deformed using a series of rapid, hammer-like blows to reduce diameter or alter cross-sectional shape.

Label: Swiss Machining
Description: A process where precision parts are produced by guiding a rotating workpiece through a fixed, programmatically controlled cutting tool, known as Swiss machining.

Label: TIG Welding
Description: A process where an electric arc forms between a non-consumable tungsten electrode and the workpiece, creating high-quality, precise welds.

Label: Tapping
Description: A process where internal threads are cut into a pre-drilled hole using a specific tool known as a tap.

Label: Tempering
Description: A process where heat-treated steel or metal is reheated to a lower temperature to increase toughness and reduce brittleness.

Label: Textile Process
Description: A process where raw materials are transformed into finished textile products through spinning, weaving, knitting, dyeing, and printing.

Label: Thermal Joining
Description: A process where materials are joined through the application of heat, causing fusion or coalescence, without significant deformation of the components.

Label: Thermal Coating
Description: A process where materials are coated with a thermal spray to enhance surface properties such as resistance to wear, heat, or corrosion.

Label: Thermal Deburring
Description: A process where excess material on workpieces is removed through controlled thermal energy, resulting in smooth, burr-free surfaces.

Label: Thermal Spray Coating
Description: A process where a coating material is heated and sprayed onto a surface to improve corrosion resistance, wear resistance, and thermal insulation.

Label: Thermal Spraying
Description: A process where molten or semi-molten materials are sprayed onto a surface to form a protective or functional coating.

Label: Thermal Subtraction
Description: A process where heat is applied to remove material layers, altering the physical properties and dimensions of the workpiece.

Label: Thermal Welding
Description: A process where heat is applied to join materials, typically metals or thermoplastics, by melting the parts and adding a filler material to form a weld pool.

Label: Thermoforming
Description: A process where a plastic sheet is heated to a pliable forming temperature, formed to a specific shape in a mold, and trimmed to create a usable product.

Label: Thin Wall Machining
Description: A process that involves the removal of material from a workpiece to create components with thin walls using precise CNC machining techniques.

Label: Thread Milling
Description: A process where a rotating cutting tool, the thread mill, is used to produce threads in a workpiece, typically via CNC machining.

Label: Thread Rolling
Description: A process where threads are formed on a workpiece by plastically deforming material using hardened dies, enhancing strength and surface finish.

Label: Threading
Description: A process that involves creating helical grooves in a cylindrical surface or hole, typically using a tap or die.

Label: Through Hardening
Description: A process that involves heating a steel part above its critical temperature, then rapidly cooling it, to increase hardness throughout the entire piece.

Label: Tin Plating
Description: A process where a thin layer of tin is electrochemically deposited onto a metal substrate to enhance corrosion resistance, solderability, and aesthetic appeal.

Label: Tool Making
Description: A process that involves designing, creating, and maintaining specialized tools used in manufacturing and production operations.

Label: Torch Brazing
Description: A process where a torch is used to melt filler metal, creating a joint between two base materials without melting them.

Label: Torch Cutting
Description: A process where a high-temperature flame, typically from an oxy-fuel torch, is used to sever, trim, or pierce metal materials.

Label: Torch Soldering
Description: A process where a torch generates heat to melt solder, creating a joint between two metal surfaces, typically in electronics or plumbing.

Label: Transfer Molding
Description: A process where pre-measured material is heated and pressurized into a mold cavity, solidifying to form a part upon cooling.

Label: Transfer Press Stamping
Description: An efficient manufacturing process used to craft medium to high volumes of metal components

Label: Trepanning
Description: A process where a rotating hollow cutter removes a core from a workpiece, creating large-diameter holes with minimal material waste.

Label: Tube Bending
Description: A process that involves deforming metal tubes into specific angles and radii using dedicated machinery and tooling.

Label: Tube Drawing
Description: A process where a tube is reduced in diameter and/or wall thickness by pulling it through a die, enhancing its mechanical properties.

Label: Tubing
Description: Tubing is a manufacturing operation used to create hollow cylindrical structures (tubes) with controlled dimensions and mechanical properties, typically from metal, plastic, or composite materials.

Label: Tufting
Description: A process where yarns are inserted into a backing material using needles to create pile surfaces, commonly employed in carpet and textile production.

Label: Tumble Finishing
Description: A process where parts are placed in a rotating barrel with abrasive media to deburr, polish, or clean surfaces through friction and impact.

Label: Tumbling
Description: A process that involves smoothing and polishing a rough surface by continuously turning it in a machine filled with abrasive substances.

Label: Turning
Description: A process that involves rotating a workpiece while a single-point cutting tool removes material, resulting in a cylindrical shape.

Label: Ultrasonic Cleaning
Description: A process where high-frequency sound waves create cavitation bubbles in a liquid to remove contaminants from solid surfaces.

Label: Ultrasonic Machining
Description: A process where high-frequency ultrasonic vibrations are applied to a tool, removing material from a workpiece through abrasive slurry, enabling precise machining.

Label: Ultrasonic Soldering
Description: A process that utilizes ultrasonic vibrations to create a reliable, flux-free metallurgical bond between dissimilar materials in soldering operations.

Label: Ultrasonic Welding
Description: A process that utilizes high-frequency ultrasonic acoustic vibrations to create solid-state welds between materials, typically plastics or lightweight metals.

Label: Unconventional Machining
Description: A process where material removal occurs through non-traditional methods such as electrical, chemical, or thermal energy, without direct mechanical contact.

Label: Upset Forging
Description: A process where metal is heated and compressed under high pressure at one end to increase its diameter, known as upset forging.

Label: Upsetting
Description: A process where metal is compressed axially to increase its diameter, enhancing mechanical properties and forming components like bolts and fasteners.

Label: Vacuum Assisted Resin Transfer Molding
Description: A process where resin is drawn into a sealed mold containing a dry fiber preform using vacuum pressure, ensuring complete saturation and void-free laminates.

Label: Vacuum Brazing
Description: A process where metals are joined at high temperatures in a vacuum environment to prevent oxidation and maintain material properties.

Label: Vacuum Casting
Description: A process where a vacuum is used to draw liquid material into a mold, ensuring precise replication of the mold's shape and details.

Label: Vacuum Forming
Description: A process where a heated thermoplastic sheet is shaped over a mold by applying vacuum pressure, creating detailed, uniform components.

Label: Vacuum Hardening
Description: A process where materials are heated in a vacuum environment and rapidly cooled to increase hardness and mechanical strength.

Label: Vacuum Molding
Description: A process where a sheet of plastic is heated to a forming temperature, stretched onto a single-surface mold, and forced against the mold by a vacuum.

Label: Vacuum Packaging
Description: A process where products are enclosed in airtight packaging under vacuum conditions to prevent oxidation, spoilage, and extend shelf life.

Label: Vacuum Pressing
Description: A process where materials are compressed and bonded under vacuum pressure, typically using heat and adhesive to form laminated or veneered products.

Label: Vacuum Thermoforming
Description: A process where a plastic sheet is heated to a pliable forming temperature, then shaped by a mold under vacuum pressure.

Label: Vapor Deposition
Description: A process where material is deposited onto a substrate in vapor form, forming a thin film through chemical or physical reactions.

Label: Vaporized Metal Coating
Description: A process where a metal is vaporized and condensed onto a substrate, forming a thin, uniform coating for enhanced surface properties.

Label: Vertical Boring
Description: A process where a rotating tool bores holes in a workpiece vertically, utilizing a vertical lathe or vertical boring mill.

Label: Vertical Milling
Description: A process where a rotating cutting tool removes material from a workpiece in a vertically oriented spindle in a milling machine.

Label: Veteran Owned
Description: Veteran-owned business status.

Label: Vibratory Deburring
Description: A process where high-frequency vibrations are used to remove burrs and imperfections from manufactured metal parts.

Label: Vibratory Finishing
Description: A process where parts are deburred, polished, or cleaned by vibrating them with abrasive media in a specially designed container.

Label: Vibratory Tumbling
Description: A process where parts are polished or deburred by placing them in a vibrating container with abrasive media, facilitating surface refinement.

Label: Virtual Location Identifier
Description: An email address or web address of an organization; every sud:EmailAddress and sud:WebAddress node also has this type.

Label: Water Quench Hardening
Description: A process where heated metal parts are rapidly cooled in water, increasing hardness and strength through the formation of martensite.

Label: Waterjet Cutting
Description: A process where high-pressure water, often mixed with abrasives, is used to cut through materials with precision and without heat-induced distortion.

Label: Wave Soldering
Description: A process where electronic components are soldered onto a PCB using a molten solder wave, ensuring efficient and uniform connections.

Label: Weaving
Description: A process that interlaces two sets of yarns at right angles to generate a fabric or textile, typically executed on a loom.

Label: Web Address
Description: A web address (URL).

Label: Wet Painting
Description: A process where a liquid paint is applied to a surface and cured, providing a protective or decorative layer on the manufactured product.

Label: Wire Bending
Description: A process where a machine or tool precisely deforms a wire into specific geometric configurations based on predefined specifications.

Label: Wire Drawing
Description: A process where a metal wire is reduced in diameter by pulling it through a series of dies under tension.

Label: Wire EDM
Description: A process that utilizes electrical discharges to cut intricate shapes or profiles into hard conductive materials with high precision.

Label: Wire Forming
Description: A process where metal wire or strip is bent, cut, and shaped using specialized machinery to produce components with precise geometries and dimensions.

Label: Wire Harness Assembly
Description: A process where individual wires, cables, and subassemblies are arranged, bound together, and fitted with connectors to form a wire harness.

Label: Wood Working
Description: A process that involves cutting, shaping, and assembling wood to construct products such as furniture, cabinetry, and sculptures.

Label: Zero Stock Machining
Description: A process where parts are produced on-demand, directly from raw materials, eliminating the need for inventory storage.

Label: Zinc Plating
Description: A process where a layer of zinc is electrochemically applied to a metal surface to provide corrosion resistance and enhance aesthetic appeal.

Label: Binder Jetting
Description: A process where a liquid binding agent selectively deposits onto a powder bed, layer by layer, to create solid parts from powdered materials.
